by licensed arms dealers subject to conditions as may be specified:
(i) Shotgun Cartridges 28 bore;
(ii) Revolver Cartridges of.450,.455 and.45 bores;
(iii) Pistol Cartridges of.25,.30 Mauser,.450 and.45 bores;
